model_annotation: The plot illustrates the number of issued building permits for new buildings ("Издадени разрешения за строеж на нови сгради") between 2012 and 2022, categorized by building type. The x-axis represents time, featuring a linear scale that ranges from "2012 г." to "2022 г." with tick labels at regular one-year intervals, though it lacks an explicit axis title. There is no visible y-axis line, label, or tick marks; instead, exact numerical values are displayed directly adjacent to the data points on each line, spanning a total range from 70 to 8169 against a linearly spaced background grid. The plot contains three solid lines without markers. The solid blue line, labeled "Административни", starts at 170 in 2012, reaches a peak of 187 in 2014, and then follows a general downward trend to end at a low of 70 in 2022. The solid orange line, labeled "Други", begins at 4938 in 2012, declines to 4323 in 2014, rises to a peak of 5460 in 2017, drops to a minimum of 3944 in 2020, and concludes at 4631 in 2022. The solid grey line, labeled "Жилищни", starts at 4238 in 2012, dips slightly to 4120 in 2013, and then exhibits a steady upward trend to 5980 in 2019, followed by a minor dip to 5860 in 2020 before rising sharply to end at a peak of 8169 in 2022.
